description: Exploit, cutting per-step cost where it is concentrated. E004's post-mortem found that the high-resolution group-1 layers (32x32 and 16x16) dominate step time. Cut group 1 from 3 convs to 2 (keep the pooling position and the 128 width). Run it on the best 768-wide config (I-768 at 9.25 epochs if that run is kept; otherwise on the incumbent), keeping the same epochs and everything else.
